query:
UPDATE issue SET title = $2, body = $3, labels = $4, parent_id = $5, project_id = $6,
                    milestone_id = $7, status = $8, linear_identifier = $9, linear_url = $10,
                    linear_updated_at = $11,
                    updated_at = CASE WHEN $12 THEN now() ELSE updated_at END
             WHERE id = $1
